subject.title: Fix silent provider-error retry after prior side effects

question: Should this PR's optional currentAttemptReplayMetadata result field and server_error retry-before-failover behavior be accepted once the branch is rebased and full-runner or gateway proof is provided?
rationale: This is a real bug fix, but it intentionally changes retry eligibility and an SDK-exported harness result shape, so automation should not decide the compatibility and session/message-delivery policy alone.

options.title: Accept after proof and rebase
options.body: Require a clean branch plus redacted full-runner or gateway evidence, then let this PR remain a candidate for the canonical fix.

options.title: Consolidate into another candidate
options.body: Use a sibling PR such as https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97966 as the canonical path and ask this branch to close only after that replacement is viable or merged.

options.title: Reject the new result field
options.body: Ask for a different current-attempt side-effect signal that avoids adding to the harness attempt-result contract.

recommendation.title: Accept after proof and rebase
recommendation.body: Require a clean branch plus redacted full-runner or gateway evidence, then let this PR remain a candidate for the canonical fix.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main blame puts the central retry gate and helper in this person's recent agent-runner rewrite, making them the best available routing candidate from local provenance.
